Product details, company information, and notices.
HARVEL Systems is an ISO 9001:2015-certified technology services organization focused on embedded hardware and software turnkey design services.

The company provides integrated engineering for industrial automation, medical technology, and embedded computing. Services include embedded hardware, FPGA and software development, turnkey system design, testing, prototyping, ODM, enclosure CAD, and onsite resourcing support.
HARVEL supports new product design, redesign, and reverse engineering, with a focus on timely delivery, quality, and continual improvement.
